M48 — 2026-10-13
An rc cut from main's own HEAD needs no merge-back PR: `git merge -s ours origin/merge-back/v<tag>` on main records the tag's ancestry while main keeps its dev version (the release commit only changes version files). Check first with `git diff --stat <cut-sha> origin/merge-back/v<tag>` that only the 9 version files differ.
